P15y: Peer counseling can become peer surveillance, even if the tone is warm. And when there are pre-reqs people have to meet to get medicine, that can put a lot of power in the hands of whoever checks them, right when people are at their most open. Even something couched in words like “willing to be seen” could become a demand that everyone disclose whatever the group wants them to.
